title: Schrödinger Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: 2025 Total Revenue of $256 Million 2025 Software Revenue of $200 Million; 2025 Software ACV of $198 Million Strong Balance Sheet Supports Path to Positive Adjusted EBITDA by Year-End 2028 Accelerating Transition to Ratable, Hosted Software Revenue Schrödinger, Inc. (Nasdaq: SDGR) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and full-year ended December 31, 2025, and provided its 2026 outlook and 2028 financial objectives.
